Sauna Benefits

The strongest sauna research links frequent use, 4 to 7 sessions a week, with lower rates of fatal heart disease, dementia, stroke, high blood pressure and respiratory illness in long-running Finnish studies. Single sessions measurably lower blood pressure. These are mostly observational findings, so they show strong associations rather than proof.

Swipe for the details. The full guide, with every source linked, is at the link in bio.
